thread:
alex: noticing odd billing diffs for websocket resumes in eu-central this morning. reconnect spikes at 07:42 correlate with route handoffs. attaching quick log sample.
mira: can you paste the log lines?
alex: sure: ```[07:42:15] conn=x1 resume_id=r-9f8 route=us-eu-1 accept=true
[07:42:16] proxy-handoff conn=x1 -> route=eu-cpool-3
[07:42:17] conn=x1 resume_id=r-9f8 route=eu-cpool-3 accept=true billed=true
``` second accept causes a billing increment.
tony: sounds like resume idempotency failing across routes during handoff. last month patch added resume_id dedupe only per-route.
mira: our sticky-lease TTL is 8s, and the handoff frequently takes ~200ms but under tail latency we occasionally lose the lease header. new route then treats it as a new session.
alex: two immediate asks: 1) split metrics in console so "resume" vs "fresh reconnect" aren't conflated; 2) short-term billing dedupe when same resume_id appears across routes within window.
tonny: (typo) tony: agreed. telemetry change: add event field `route_transition` minimal encoding like `prev:us-eu-1|next:eu-cpool-3` and include trace_id. keep payload <= 128 bytes.
mira: console-bot: can we get a dashboard snapshot?
console-bot: https://console.redwood.ai/d/streams/handshake?from=07:30&to=07:50 (shows spike)
alex: for rollout: propose feature flag `resume-global-dedupe-v1` gated in eu-central at 10% for 6h. also increase sticky-lease TTL to 20s under that flag.
tonny: implement billing-side dedupe: aggregator dedupe on (customer_id, resume_id) within 45s unless explicitly new_session=true. low-impact and reversible.
mira: UX: add hover text on metric: "Resume = client used resume_id to continue previous session; Fresh reconnect = no resume_id." Also add a drilldown table showing resume_id, route_before, route_after, trace_id.
alex: ops: add oncall playbook note: when billing diff seen, check `streams.route_transitions` and `billing.duplicate_counts`.
devops-bot: feature flag created: resume-global-dedupe-v1 in eu-central. owner: tony.
tonny: i'll open a tiny PR with three parts: telemetry (route_transition + trace_id), billing aggregator dedupe, and flag-driven TTL bump. test plan: run the handoff-replay harness and assert one billing event per resume_id.
mira: sampling note: also include a sampled client_resume_attempts counter (0.5%) to detect noisy clients without large storage hit.
alex: alert changes: current alert fires on reconnects > 180/min. split alerts: fresh_reconnects > 40/min (page), resume_events > 400/min (paged but lower severity). tune after 24h baseline.
tonny: PR draft: https://git.redwood.ai/r/s/4567 (WIP).
alex: thanks everyone. let's hold off customer comms until we verify dedupe effectiveness in canary.
console-bot: dashboard annotation added for canary start time.
summary: Duplicate billing caused when resume accepted on origin then accepted again after proxy handoff to new route. Action: split metrics in console, add minimal route_transition telemetry, billing-side dedupe on resume_id, TTL bump behind feature flag, sampling client resume attempts, update alerts and runbook.
